# LineChart

Time series — CPU, RAM, network, disk I/O over time.

`KenosUI.LineChart` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.LineChart data={…} series={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.LineChart" data="{{…}}" series="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Time series: crosshair tooltip with every series, keyboard (←→ Home End), legend for ≥ 2 series, table view.

## Props (LineChartProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` * | `Array<Record<string, any>>` |  |
| `x` | `string` | Key of the x value (Date, epoch ms, number or label). Default "t". |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `height` | `number` | Plot height in px incl. x-axis. Default 200. |
| `area` | `boolean` | Fill under the line at 10 %. AreaChart = LineChart with area. |
| `unit` | `string` |  |
| `yMin` | `number` |  |
| `yMax` | `number` |  |
| `formatValue` | `(v: number) => string` |  |
| `formatX` | `(x: any) => string` |  |
| `thresholds` | `Array<{ value: number; label?: string }>` | Horizontal reference lines in accent red, e.g. [{ value: 90, label: "Alarm" }]. |
| `endLabels` | `boolean` | Label line ends with the series name (2–4 series, when they don't collide). Default true. |
| `table` | `boolean` | "Als Tabelle" toggle. Default true. |
| `xLabel` | `string` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Holds the last render at 50 % while refetching. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |

### ChartSeries

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` * | `string` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `color` | `string \| number` | "ink" \| "accent" \| 1–4 \| "other" \| any CSS colour. Default: ink for one series, chart-1…4 in order. |
